shortIntro.title: What Your Device Really Needs for Smooth Dream League Soccer Gameplay ⚽📱
shortIntro.para1: Dream League Soccer (DLS) is all about fluid ball movement, smart positioning, and those clutch goals that make you jump off the couch like a madman 😎🔥. While the game looks lightweight, it still relies on stable hardware to handle AI logic, player animations, and match replays without hiccups.
shortIntro.para2: A single stutter during a one-on-one chance or lag while defending a late corner can flip a guaranteed win into pure pain 💔😅. The good news? DLS is well-optimized and forgiving if your device meets the right baseline specs.

intro: Below are the updated minimum and recommended system requirements to enjoy Dream League Soccer on Android and iOS with smooth matches, fast loading screens, and zero rage quits 😄⚽.

minimum.RAM: 2GB minimum (runs fine, but keep expectations realistic ✨)
minimum.Internet: Not required for offline career matches (huge win 🏆)

recommended.RAM: 4GB or more for stable FPS and smoother replays 💨
recommended.Internet: Optional – needed only for online modes 🌐

ios_intro: Dream League Soccer feels right at home on iOS 🍏. Thanks to solid optimization, even older iPhones deliver consistent gameplay with minimal frame drops.

ios_recommended.title: Device
ios_recommended.value: iPhone X / XR / 11 Series or newer

fps_intro: DLS doesn’t chase extreme FPS numbers, but smoother frames always mean better control and cleaner gameplay ⚽👌.
settings_intro: A few smart tweaks can make Dream League Soccer feel noticeably smoother, especially on budget or older phones 📱⚙️.

low_end.title: Graphics Quality
low_end.value: Low or Medium for consistent frame rates

low_end.title: Crowd Detail
low_end.value: Lower it to avoid drops during celebrations

low_end.title: Replays
low_end.value: Shorten or skip to reduce memory load

low_end.title: Background Apps
low_end.value: Close unused apps to prevent stutter 😅

high_end.title: Graphics Quality
high_end.value: High for sharper players and stadium visuals ✨

high_end.title: Replays
high_end.value: Enable full replays for cinematic goals 😎

sectionIntro: These Android and iOS devices deliver a reliable Dream League Soccer experience with smooth gameplay and quick match loading:
androidDevices: Samsung Galaxy A14 / A24 / A34 / S21 Series
storageIntroText: Dream League Soccer stays relatively lightweight compared to many football titles, but updates still stack up over time 📦⚽:
faqIntroText: FAQs for Dream League Soccer – quick answers to keep your matches smooth and stress-free 😄⚽:

faqList.question: Is Dream League Soccer heavy on phones?
faqList.answer: No 👍 DLS is lightweight and optimized for low to mid-range devices.

faqList.question: Can Dream League Soccer be played offline?
faqList.answer: Yes 📴 Career mode works fully offline without internet.

faqList.question: Why does the game lag during goal replays?
faqList.answer: Replay animations and crowd effects can stress low-end hardware. Lower graphics settings to fix it.
